title: Ravi and the Golden Shell
description: A little Indian boy named Ravi discovers a magical golden shell on the beach, leading him on a warm, storybook-style adventure.

scenes.description: Ravi walks barefoot along the golden sandy beach, gentle ocean waves at his feet, warm sunset light all around.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) (full scene view) little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, walking along golden sandy beach, gentle ocean waves, warm sunset light, storybook illustration style, soft hand-painted look, natural proportions, warm colors (wide shot)
scenes.narration: Ravi loved walking on the beach every evening, feeling the soft sand under his feet and the warm breeze on his face.

scenes.description: Ravi spots a shimmering golden shell half-buried in the sand.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) (full scene view) little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, kneeling on golden sandy beach, picking up glowing golden shell, gentle ocean waves in background, warm sunset light, storybook illustration style, soft hand-painted look, natural proportions, warm colors (wide shot)
scenes.narration: One evening, something sparkled in the sand — a beautiful golden shell, glowing softly in the sunlight.

scenes.description: The shell glows brighter, releasing soft golden sparkles into the air.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) (full scene view) little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, holding glowing golden shell in both hands, golden sparkles rising into the air, ocean waves behind, warm evening light, storybook illustration style, soft hand-painted look, natural proportions, magical atmosphere (wide shot)
scenes.narration: As Ravi held it, the shell began to glow even brighter, sending golden sparkles dancing into the air.

scenes.description: A magical pathway of light appears over the ocean.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) (full scene view) little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, standing at water's edge, looking at glowing golden light pathway stretching across the ocean, magical sparkles in the air, warm sunset colors, storybook illustration style, soft hand-painted look, natural proportions, magical atmosphere (wide shot)
scenes.narration: Before his eyes, a path of golden light appeared across the water, inviting him to follow.

scenes.description: Ravi follows the path and finds a hidden island with colorful flowers and palm trees.

scenes.narration: He stepped carefully along the glowing path until he reached a secret island filled with bright flowers and tall palm trees.

scenes.description: Ravi places the shell on a rock, releasing a wave of magic that brightens the island.
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) (full scene view) little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, placing glowing golden shell on large smooth rock, magical wave of golden light spreading across tropical island, flowers blooming, palm leaves swaying, warm sunset glow, storybook illustration style, soft hand-painted look, natural proportions, magical tone (wide shot)
